signs.aries: You work in sprints and burn out on routine, need physical exertion to stay well, and are impatient with anyone slower than you.
signs.taurus: You work steadily and dislike being hurried, keep the same habits for years, and your health depends on regular food and sleep.
signs.gemini: You need variety in your working day, do several jobs at once, and your health is affected by how busy your mind is.
signs.cancer: You need to feel at home where you work and take the atmosphere of the office personally; your health follows your mood closely.
signs.leo: You need your work to be seen and appreciated, put your name on what you do, and lose energy when you feel taken for granted.
signs.virgo: This is where you are most competent: methodical, thorough, and quietly anxious about health and about doing the job properly.
signs.libra: You work best in partnership and badly in conflict, and the fairness of a workplace matters to you more than the pay.
signs.scorpio: You work intensely and privately, are drawn to jobs others avoid, and treat your own health as something to be investigated.
signs.sagittarius: You need freedom and variety in your working day, resist being managed closely, and are casual about health until you are not.
signs.capricorn: Your working day is structured to the hour and your job title matters to you more than you admit; the strain settles in your back, knees and teeth.
signs.aquarius: You do the job your own way, question the standard procedure as a matter of course, and are drawn to unusual or technical work.
signs.pisces: Routine dissolves the moment you stop enforcing it, and your symptoms are the vague kind that doctors find hard to pin down.
